calls.statement:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS n_ids,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line l JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=l.product_key WHERE l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders,
  MIN(order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_all, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS ids_all,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'cancelled') AS orders_utc_day,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND status<>'cancelled') AS orders_helsinki_day,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order x WHERE CAST(x.order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND status<>'cancelled' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order y WHERE y.web_order_id=x.web_order_id AND y.order_ts_utc<>x.order_ts_utc)) AS dup_diff_ts
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-27' AND DATE '2025-11-29'
